title: Correctness Fixes
description: Fix CRITICAL and worst MAJOR findings from the forge-audit: CNCSimulationPipelineEngine formula errors, calcDispatcher 261 unreachable actions, cadDispatcher 24 missing actions, and inline physics replacement in 8 engines. Target quality scores: CNCSimulation 27→75, calcDispatcher 43→85, all others 80+.

units.title: Fix Kienzle force formula
units.description: Fix Kienzle formula to Fc = kc1_1 * ap * fz^(1-mc) (not ae-based). Import constants from src/physics/constants.ts. Add tool material E modulus lookup from CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS.
acceptance: Kienzle formula uses correct ap-based formulation
Constants imported from src/physics/constants.ts
Tool material E modulus resolved from CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS

units.title: Fix Taylor tool life formula
units.description: Fix Taylor formula to T = (C/Vc)^(1/n) (not C/V^n). Import Taylor constants from src/physics/constants.ts.
acceptance: Taylor formula uses correct T = (C/Vc)^(1/n) formulation
Taylor constants imported from canonical source

units.title: CNCSimulation regression tests
units.description: Add 5+ regression tests validating corrected Kienzle and Taylor formulas against known reference values for multiple materials and cutting conditions.
acceptance: 5+ regression tests pass
Tests cover at least 3 different ISO material groups
Build: 0 errors

acceptance: All 261 missing actions added to ACTIONS z.enum
